firstPlayerRule: The player on the dealer’s left turns up the first card, then play continues to the left.
houseFallback: The page does not say who deals; use the picker to choose the dealer.
clarifications: Anyone can slap a jack, so the first turn gives no real advantage.

internalEvidence: Read the Bicycle Cards Slapjack page in a browser. "Beginning on the dealer’s left, each player lifts one card at a time from their pile and places it face up in the center of the table."
uncertainty: The page does not say how the dealer is chosen.
